sources.title: Google's TipsV2-G14-DPT Depth Estimation Model Lands on Modelers.cn ...
sources.snippet: What makes TipsV2-G14-DPT especially interesting is its presence on Modelers.cn, the model hub built for the Huawei/Ascend AI ecosystem. This suggests - though the card does not explicitly confirm - that the model has been tested or optimised for Ascend NPUs.

sources.title: GitHub - google-deepmind/tips: TIPSv2 (CVPR'26) and TIPS (ICLR'25)
sources.snippet: We provide both Pytorch and Jax (Scenic) implementations: tips/pytorch/: PyTorch inference for the model. tips/scenic/: Jax-based inference using the scenic library. We provide links to all available checkpoints, for both Pytorch and Jax model definitions, together with representative evals. You can also find TIPSv2 models on HuggingFace here.
